lead.event: IDX removes high-shareholding-concentration stocks from boards and index evaluations
lead.headline: IDX schedules HSC stock removals from boards and index evaluations, with 346 board exits
lead.blurb: Under the revised test, a stock is classified as high shareholding concentration (HSC) when its 10 largest shareholders collectively own at least 92.5%, with the previous Rp5 trillion market-cap threshold and Price Impact Ratio parameter dropped. IDX announced 4 Acceleration, 233 Development and 109 Main Board constituents exiting. The changes take effect on 30 November for boards and 1 December for index evaluations. HSC stocks have been excluded from the IHSG calculation since 13 November, IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said.

macro_flows.event: MSCI's Indonesia market reclassification consultation and reported presidential call
macro_flows.headline: MSCI keeps Indonesia reclassification under consultation, with decision due by 30 June 2027
macro_flows.blurb: Prabowo and MSCI CEO Henry Fernandez reportedly held an hour-long call on 10 November, with Fernandez reportedly open to alternatives. MSCI says public input remains open until 30 April 2027 and that a move from emerging to standalone status could remove Indonesian stocks from its indexes. No decision has been made.
macro_flows.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

macro_flows.event: Bank Indonesia reports growth in digital payment transactions through October
macro_flows.headline: Bank Indonesia reports digital payments up 31.47% to 6.18 billion through October
macro_flows.blurb: BTN said Balé transactions reached 2.5 billion, up 40% year on year, lifting fee-based income more than 41% in the first ten months. BCA’s myBCA frequency rose 40% year on year in the first nine months, while Maybank Indonesia recorded over 48 million transactions worth Rp870 trillion through Q3, up 34%.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia and the EU sign IEU-CEPA and an investment protection agreement
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia and EU sign IEU-CEPA and investment pact, with 90.4% of lines duty-free
market_structure_policy.blurb: The agreements take effect on 1 January 2027. Another 8.37% of Indonesian tariff lines to the EU will have duties reduced over 3–15 years or through tariff-rate quotas.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in trading-related fines on DSSA, BREN, and CUAN
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in fines on DSSA, BREN and CUAN
market_structure_policy.blurb: Dian Swastatika Sentosa received Rp1.5 trillion, Barito Renewables Rp500 billion and Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Rp100 billion in penalties over alleged market manipulation and public-offering violations. Analysts at Korea Investment & Sekuritas and RHB Sekuritas said the action addresses one MSCI concern, but Emerging Market status depends on changes through 30 April 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: ADHI bond interest delay leads to an IDX trading suspension
market_structure_policy.headline: ADHI defers Rp60.82 billion bond interest as IDX extends trading suspension
market_structure_policy.blurb: The payment was the 18th interest on Adhi Karya’s 2022 Series B and C bonds, due 24 November. Bondholders rejected an installment plan for the 17th, 18th and 19th interest obligations at meetings on 6 August and 30 October. Adhi Karya plans another bondholder meeting and will coordinate with trustee Bank Mega.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia obtains approval for a 6.8-billion-share rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS shareholders approve rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The shares have a stated maximum nominal amount of Rp3.4 trillion, but the issue value and funding target are not set. Final terms remain subject to board determination, OJK registration and listing on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Finance and Strategy Director Ade Cahyo Nugroho said the issue could temporarily pressure earnings per share.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: APIC plans a bond issue of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: APIC plans bond issue of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pacific Strategic Financial would use Rp400 billion to repay its principal debt to SMBC Indonesia, with the remainder funding investment portfolio development in financial instruments and financial services companies. Series A matures on 17 January 2028 and Series B on 7 January 2030, with fixed quarterly interest and bullet principal repayment.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bumi Atsiri Prima prepares its initial public offering
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Bumi Atsiri Prima plans IPO of up to 534 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The offering covers 25.02% of fully paid-up capital at a book-building range of Rp135–Rp190 per share, with proceeds of up to Rp101.46 billion. All proceeds will fund working capital, allocated approximately 70% to patchouli oil, 20% to nutmeg oil and 10% to massoia bark purchases. The company plans to list in November, with no exact date stated.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: BUAT allocated IPO proceeds approximately 70% to patchouli oil, 20% to nutmeg oil and 10% to massoia bark purchases.

earnings_guidance.event: MDKA reports a return to profit in 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: MDKA returns to profit with US$157 million net profit in 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Copper Gold posted Q3 revenue of US$858 million, up 10% quarter on quarter, and cumulative revenue of US$2.26 billion, up 76%, through September. Phintraco Sekuritas sees up to 122% upside for the shares.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Tabungan Negara reports nine-month profit growth and revises 2026 targets
earnings_guidance.headline: Bank Tabungan Negara reports 22.6% nine-month profit growth, revises 2026 targets
earnings_guidance.blurb: BTN’s net profit reached Rp2.82 trillion for the first nine months as its cost of funds fell to 3.3% from 4.1% and provision expenses dropped 34.4% to Rp2.93 trillion. It raised full-year financing growth guidance to 8%-11% and cut third-party funds growth guidance to 3%-5%.

earnings_guidance.event: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: PANI reports 145% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua’s revenue rose about 19%, and marketing sales reached Rp3 trillion by end-September. Residential sales led at Rp1.63 trillion, up 34%, while liabilities fell 10.4% to Rp16.9 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS reports nine-month net profit up 10% to Rp6.13 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia said operating income rose 9.40% year on year to Rp21.21 trillion through September. Its financing-to-deposit ratio increased to 90.04% from 86.29%, tightening liquidity as financing grew faster than deposits.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The financing-to-deposit ratio rose to 90.04% from 86.29%, tightening liquidity.

deals_control.event: DMS Propertindo plans a rights issue to fund two acquisitions
deals_control.headline: KOTA plans Rp4.95 trillion rights issue for two acquisitions
deals_control.blurb: DMS Propertindo would allocate Rp1.2 trillion to acquire a 99.99% stake in Art Design Indonesia and Rp3.2 trillion for a 99.99% stake in Mandirinusa Graha Perkasa, with remaining proceeds for working capital, operations and business development. Shareholders vote on the plan on 27 November, and approval would start a 12-month implementation window.

deals_control.event: Bayan Resources reshuffles its board after Haji Isam-linked share acquisition
deals_control.headline: BYAN names Ary Bastari president director after Jhonlin takes 30.25% stake
deals_control.blurb: At the 23 November extraordinary general meeting, Bastari replaced Low Tuck Kwong. Jhonlin Baratama completed its October share purchase from Low and Elaine Low, leaving it with 30.25% of issued capital. The meeting also appointed three other directors and named Budi Waseso independent president commissioner.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: IGAR plans a share buyback as part of its go-private and delisting process
deals_control.headline: IGAR plans Rp163.44 billion buyback for go-private and delisting process
deals_control.blurb: The planned purchase covers up to 155.66 million public shares, about 16.78% of fully placed and paid-up shares, at Rp1,050 each. Champion Pacific says the transition is intended to improve operational efficiency and competitiveness and that it has no plans to seek capital-market funding in the foreseeable future. IDX suspended trading in IGAR shares on 16 October.
